edges.reason: msg.sender is stored as the tax wallet in the constructor, granting it privileged control.
transfer uses _msgSender() as the source of the transfer.
transfer forwards execution to _transfer.
recipient parameter of transfer flows into _transfer.
amount parameter of transfer flows into _transfer.
_transfer calls _tokenTransfer to perform balance updates.
_tokenTransfer dispatches to _transferStandard.
_transferStandard calls _takeTeam for the team fee.
_transferStandard calls _reflectFee for the reflection fee.
tAmount parameter is fed into _getValues.
_getValues calls _getTValues.
_getValues calls _getRValues.
_getValues calls _getRate to obtain the current rate.
_getRate calls _getCurrentSupply.
_getRate reads _rTotal through _getCurrentSupply.
_reflectFee subtracts the reflection fee from _rTotal, affecting reflection math.
_reflectFee adds the token fee to _tFeeTotal.
tokenFromReflection calls _getRate before dividing.
balanceOf converts reflection balance via tokenFromReflection.
account parameter of balanceOf indexes _rOwned.
_transfer computes contractTokenBalance via balanceOf(address(this)).
contractTokenBalance is passed as the swap amount.
_transfer conditionally triggers swapTokensForEth.
_transfer reads address(this).balance into contractETHBalance.
contractETHBalance is passed to sendETHToFee.
_transfer calls sendETHToFee when the ETH threshold is reached.
tokenAmount parameter controls the amount swapped.
swapTokensForEth performs an external router call with attacker-controllable effects.
The router swap call can re-enter _transfer before state settles.
sendETHToFee performs the ETH transfer to the tax wallet.
amount parameter determines the ETH value transferred to _taxWallet.
ETH transfer to an arbitrary _taxWallet can re-enter _transfer.
block.timestamp is used as the swap deadline, making execution timestamp dependent.
block.timestamp is used as the addLiquidityETH deadline in startTrading.
onlyTaxCollector compares msg.sender with _taxWallet before startTrading runs.
startTrading calls the factory createPair external function.
startTrading calls addLiquidityETH on the router.
startTrading approves the pair for the router with max allowance.
addLiquidityETH is an external payable call that can re-enter transfer logic.
lowerTax is gated by onlyTaxCollector checking msg.sender against _taxWallet.
removeBuyLimit is gated by onlyTaxCollector checking msg.sender against _taxWallet.
manualSwap is gated by onlyTaxCollector checking msg.sender against _taxWallet.
manualSend is gated by onlyTaxCollector checking msg.sender against _taxWallet.
newTaxRate parameter is validated and assigned to the fee.
lowerTax writes the new value into _taxFee.
removeBuyLimit sets _maxTxAmount to the total supply.
manualSwap invokes swapTokensForEth on the contract balance.
manualSend invokes sendETHToFee with the contract ETH balance.
transferFrom routes the transfer through _transfer.
transferFrom reads and decreases _allowances using the caller and spender.
approve forwards to _approve.
_approve writes the allowance into _allowances.

normalization_plan.reason: The amount parameter only exists to feed the transfer entry point and its internal flow.
The recipient parameter is consumed solely by transfer.
The newTaxRate parameter is only meaningful inside the lowerTax privilege function.
The tokenAmount parameter only parameterizes the swapTokensForEth routine.
The tAmount parameter belongs to the internal transfer math function.
Local balance cache computed and used entirely within _transfer.
Local ETH balance cache computed and used entirely within _transfer.
The ETH amount parameter only flows into the sendETHToFee payout routine.
The account parameter is only used to index reflection balances in balanceOf.
